facts.business: Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited manufactures electrical accessories, wires, cables, switchgears, LED lighting, and has diversified into modular switches, polytech products, and appliances through subsidiaries.
facts.related_party_note: During the financial year 2025-26, there was no materially significant related party transaction that may have potential conflict with the interests of the Company at large. Details of related party transactions in accordance with AS–18 are given in Notes to Accounts. The Company has not made any loans and advances to firms/companies in which directors are interested except wholly owned subsidiaries.
